_comment: Article schema with real author entity — the foundation of E-E-A-T for AI-assisted content.

example.headline: Best Cap Table Management Tools — Ranked for 2026
example.description: A data-driven ranking of the top cap table platforms for startups, with methodology, pricing, and real-world comparison.

author.name: Your Name
author.description: 3x founder, 65+ investments. Building at the intersection of finance and technology.

notes: ALWAYS use a real Person as author, never a fake name
The sameAs array lets Google verify the author exists across the web
dateModified should update whenever content is refreshed — this signals freshness
The author URL should point to a real page with bio, credentials, and links to published work
